{{Short description|Study of the tropical semiring}}
In the mathematical discipline of [[idempotent analysis]], '''tropical analysis''' is the study of the [[tropical semiring]].

== Applications ==
The max tropical semiring can be used appropriately to determine marking times within a given [[Petri net]] and a vector filled with marking state at the beginning: <math>-\infty</math> (unit for max, tropical addition) means "never before", while 0 (unit for addition, tropical multiplication) is "no additional time".

[[Tropical cryptography]] is cryptography based on the tropical semiring.

[[Tropical geometry]] is an analog to [[algebraic geometry]], using the tropical semiring.
